THE KERNEL OF NEWFORM DEDEKIND SUMS
EVUILYNN NGUYEN, JUAN J. RAMIREZ, AND MATTHEW P. YOUNG
Abstract. Newform Dedekind sums are a class of crossed homomorphisms that arise from
newform Eisenstein series. We initiate a study of the kernel of these newform Dedekind sums.
Our results can be loosely described as showing that these kernels are neither “too big” nor
“too small.” We conclude with an observation about the Galois action on Dedekind sums
that allows for signiﬁcant computational eﬃciency in the numerical calculation of Dedekind
